items.name: VIT Rubik's Cube Challenge 2017
items.information: Hard copy of original ID proof is MANDATORY for all competitors. On the spot registration is necessary even if you register online and will be open till sunday 10:00 AM. In registration desk each external participants has to pay an amount of 500Rs as a caution deposit and it is refundable. Please refer WCA regulations for more information, feel free to contact @Thabares Nazeer +91 8608576123 and @Sachin Arvind +91 9677970959
